svg.text: GridAware — Wordmark Pairing Study (Direction A: Node G)
Each candidate is custom-kerned, outlined to pure vector paths, and features a bespoke Node-squircle tittle on "i". Shown on EVARAX Dark (#080808), at 28px sidebar scale, and Light Badge (#FFFFFF).
